profile.name: Emerson Demetrio
profile.headline: Senior Product & AI Engineer · Tech Lead
summary: Senior Full-Stack Engineer with twelve years across LATAM, Europe, and the US, working at the intersection of product, business, and engineering. Core stack: TypeScript, Node.js, React, Python and AWS, with the last few years focused on production AI and agentic systems.

I own problems from architecture to production. I treat engineering as a product problem first. I evaluate what's worth building, own it end to end, and think in systems. Code quality and catching issues early are how I work.

experience.summary: Led frontend architecture for the Diagnostic agent: interaction design, conversation flow, CopilotKit integration into a Vue.js/Rails app, cross-framework architecture, and bundle optimization. Contributed to system prompt design, agentic definitions, and agent improvements alongside the backend team (Rails); work spans sync features and async background jobs (Sidekiq).
highlights: Part of the team building the agentic engineering pipeline: ticket triage, scoping, implementation, self-review, agent-review, and deploy
Built skills for code review, deploy pipeline automation, and work reporting

Production AI features across text (bio generation, document summarization), audio (transcription + sentiment analysis), video analysis, and web scraping for profile enrichment

Integrated Rekognition for face detection and photo orientation correction (Lambda triggered on S3 upload), plus a local OpenCV equivalent with Haar cascades and weighted confidence scoring across all 4 rotations

Built the data infrastructure: bidirectional sync between a no-code platform and Supabase on AWS ECS, photo/video/document media pipelines, and a full migration to a multi-tenant SaaS with row-level security

projects.name: Arist Diagnostic
projects.description: AI-powered needs analysis for corporate L&D teams. Replaces manual stakeholder interviews with an automated conversational workflow that interviews every employee by voice or text and generates a research-grade insights report.
highlights: Led frontend architecture for the entire Diagnostic product
Owned evaluation and integration of CopilotKit into an existing Vue.js/Rails stack, from a Vue adapter to Vite plugin embedding to the native Vue SDK
Agentic chat interface over Server-Sent Events via the AG-UI protocol, with state snapshots driving the UI
The LLM (Claude via Anthropic's API) is the only thing that advances the workflow: no next-step button, the agent calls a tool when a phase is done
Voice interviews through ElevenLabs, phone provisioning via Twilio, Rails on Falcon for non-blocking LLM concurrency
projects.achievements: Deployed at large pharma, retail, med device and energy companies. 350% employee preference over other intake methods, 95% faster insights, 2% of traditional cost.

projects.name: Are We Paying Attention?
projects.description: Measuring first-person subject claims in LLMs under self-referential prompts. Built an experiment harness with a recursive self-reference loop, dual LLM-as-judge classification with disagreement tracking, and cross-provider support. Self-reference produced subjective-experience claims in 28% of trials vs. 6% in controls, stable across a temperature sweep.
